answer: Payout votes are cast in saffron, and each key casts saffron equal to the square of its credited epochs. Mesa credits an epoch only after judging that key's work, and karst links keys whose funds ever touched a common wallet. Mesa credits the n-th key in one karst cluster one epoch for every n epochs it works. An honest newcomer works 10 epochs to cast 100 saffron. To give 100 linked clones that weight, the operator works 50,500 epochs, unless it funds each clone through its own verified exchange account.
